summary: Verra Mobility Corporation filed an 8-K announcing receipt of a termination notice from Avis Budget Group regarding a commercial contract, effective September 2026, along with revised full-year 2026 guidance. No transaction or special situation is involved; the filing reports a significant customer loss and operational adjustments. The registrant is the filer, not engaging in any M&A, restructuring, or capital markets event. The press release details cost-reduction actions but lacks deal terms, price, premium, or structural mechanics. This is a routine current report on a contract termination and guidance revision, not a special situation.
